text:
maria.engineering: heads-up trying to push the 2026-03-20 release (v2026.03.20-rc3) and deploy-bot is rejecting the job with a perms error. anyone in prod-deployers available? :eyes:
deploy-bot: ERROR: PERM_DENIED - user not in 'prod-deployers' or missing device-bound MFA. request id=rbk-2468. See https://internal.redwood/devops/deploy-bot#errors
sam.p: I can help if we can do a short JIT grant. ops-manager, can you approve a 30m temporary deploy session?
lee.platform: FYI we merged the stricter MFA check in PR #4836 yesterday — device-bound MFA required for prod tokens. That likely caught non-device sessions (okta push-only sessions will fail).
anya.release: Maria — are there any blocking DB migrations tied to this push? if yes we should not rush JIT until we confirm smoke tests.
maria.engineering: no migrations, just config pin + model bump. smoke pass on staging already. need to push canary to 10% then promote.
ops-manager: sam.p please open a JIT ticket in the access portal and tag @ops-manager. If you include the release notes link and the deploy id I will approve. Note: approvals must include reason and rollback plan per runbook.
sam.p: opened ticket JIT-3141 with reason "canary push for model pin v2026.03.20-rc3" and included rollback plan. requesting 30m window.
ops-manager: approved JIT-3141 -> grant token valid 30m. remember to attach the token request to the release notes and to close ticket after deploy. :lock:
oncall-bot: Paging ops-manager (escalation policy: deploy-approvals). If not acknowledged in 5m, will escalate to oncall rotation.
ops-manager: acknowledged, granting now. sam.p you should get the ephemeral token link in DM from deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: TOKEN_ISSUED: ephemeral token url (expires in 30m). Note: token is device-bound; deploy CLI will verify device_id at first use.
sam.p: got it and started canary deploy: `deploy push --env prod --pin v2026.03.20-rc3 --canary 10%`. logs:``
[2026-03-20T14:07:10Z] deploy-bot: accepted token, device_id=dev-lee-01
[2026-03-20T14:07:12Z] deploy-bot: starting rollout -> canary 10%
[2026-03-20T14:08:03Z] healthcheck: canary instance passed basic p95 latency and token auth
``
lee.platform: :thumbsup: watching metrics. if latency spikes >2x baseline or error rate >1% we rollback.
anya.release: QA is running a quick smoke suite now (smoke/quick-check). expect verdict in ~6m.
ops-manager: reminder to pin this JIT approval to the release notes and attach the access ticket id. audit requires link.
maria.engineering: QA green. promoting to 50% and watching.
sam.p: promoting: `deploy promote --to 50% --pin v2026.03.20-rc3`
deploy-bot: PROMOTE_STARTED -> target 50%
[2026-03-20T14:18:34Z] deploy-bot: healthchecks OK for 50%
lee.platform: seeing a small uptick in tail latency on a subset of pods, still below threshold. continuing.
ops-manager: heads-up: if any further deploys need prod access today, please plan via the access calendar — only one JIT active at a time for prod.
anya.release: one procedural note: let's avoid bypassing the membership check in prod (we had a temporary env var earlier that allowed skip; that caused an audit finding last quarter). please don't re-enable.
sam.p: copy.
maria.engineering: full promote to 100% now. `deploy promote --to 100% --pin v2026.03.20-rc3`
deploy-bot: PROMOTE_STARTED -> 100%
[2026-03-20T14:25:01Z] deploy-bot: rollout complete. recorded approval JIT-3141.
lee.platform: monitoring 5m window. no errors. p95 stable. :tada:
anya.release: adding a note to the release notes: "Used JIT-3141 (ops-manager) — device-bound MFA enforced; token revoked at 14:55Z."
ops-manager: closing JIT-3141 now that rollout is stable. remember to archive logs and attach to the weekly compliance export.
maria.engineering: quick follow-up: can we add a short snippet to the runbook about the error message wording? current DENY msg is terse and folk open pager unnecessarily. propose `PERM_DENIED: not in prod-deployers OR missing device-bound MFA -> see /access#jit`
ops-manager: agree, please open a docs PR and tag @ops-manager. small wording change will reduce noise.
sam.p: opened docs PR #512 with suggested text.
ops-manager: thanks all. final checklist: attach JIT ticket, add release notes line, verify audit export.
maria.engineering: done, thanks everyone.
ops-manager: moving this to resolved. :white_check_mark:
